safe library recovery opens exact historical values without registering an editable old module or mutating records
safe library recovery persists and restores new draft sets separately, including their subsequent edits
safe library recovery leaves a compatible library untouched on load and preserves additional fields on save
safe library recovery isolates malformed definitions, preferences and duplicate set identities without discarding other records
safe library recovery preserves malformed whole libraries and never overwrites an unreadable storage source
safe library recovery protects a legacy v2-only source and identifies the correct raw export key
safe library recovery refuses stale-tab and direct-create writes when existing storage was not safely loaded
safe library recovery never rotates or removes a recovery snapshot during repeated draft saves
safe library recovery blocks concurrent writes while the recovery snapshot is still pending
